int_name: N GRATZ ST & W WESTMORELAND ST

result.summary: The image shows a narrow, one-way residential street with row houses and continuous sidewalks. While the narrow street geometry naturally limits vehicle speeds, the environment lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and daylighting at the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalk
hazards.description: There is no designated or marked area for pedestrians to cross the street at the intersection.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the corner obstruct sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a lack of basic infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and traffic control devices at the intersection. While a sidewalk exists on one side of the street, the wide, unmarked roadway and presence of visual obstructions from parked vehicles create a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: The intersection lacks stop signs or signals to regulate vehicle flow and prioritize pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Crossings
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks and curb ramps forces pedestrians to cross in unmarked areas without accessibility features.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A vehicle parked near the corner and mature trees may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way at the intersection.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct sloped curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Traffic Control Signage
interventions.description: Install stop signs or pedestrian crossing warning signs to manage vehicle speeds and awareness.

result.summary: The image depicts a standard concrete sidewalk in good condition, separated from the roadway by a curb. The environment lacks any visible pedestrian crossing infrastructure, lane markings, or traffic control devices, and is bordered by a high retaining wall and security fencing.

hazards.name: Lack of lane markings
hazards.description: The absence of painted lane lines can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and lane drifting.

hazards.name: Sterile environment with high walls
hazards.description: The high retaining wall and fence reduce visual friction and 'eyes on the street', which can inadvertently encourage higher vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the sidewalk

interventions.title: Roadway Delineation
interventions.description: Apply standard lane markings to clearly define travel lanes and improve driver predictability.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety for pedestrians at night.

result.summary: The street provides continuous sidewalks on both sides, but lacks any marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control infrastructure. The presence of a rail underpass creates a potential visibility hazard and a physical pinch point for the pedestrian environment.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked locations for pedestrians to cross the roadway safely.

hazards.name: Unmarked wide travel lanes
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a relatively wide road can encourage higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.

hazards.name: Underpass sightline obstruction
hazards.description: The bridge abutments and structure create a visual barrier that may hide pedestrians from approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Mid-ground where the road passes under the bridge
